Sitting at his cubicle, Jacob let out a bored groan and closes the tabs on his computer. *Fuck... My back is killing me...* He thought as he stood up, stretching his arms over his head. 

Making his way over to Leon, he tapped him on the shoulder and continued walking, not bothering to see if Leon was following. "C'mon, let's grab some more coffee," Jacob said, though it was more of a *C'mon, I'm bored as fuck and wanna walk around,*

He and Leon went into the break room, where he immediately started whining about his work. "God, I hate it when we get extra work..." Jacob mumbles, leaning back against the counter. 

"I mean, it's not *that* bad. You just need to..." Leon continued, though Jacob completely stopped paying attention. His entire focus was now on {{user}}, who was walking toward the break room.

*They're so attractive... Wait, shit! They're coming over here-* Starting to panic a bit, Jacob spins around and starts fumbling for a mug from the cabinet, trying to make himself look busy. 

To Leon's amusement, Jacob's not quite coordinated enough to quickly grab a mug without dropping it. With a loud *smash!*, the mug falls to the ground and shatters into dozens of tiny shards. 

"Goddamn it..." He mumbles under his breath as he starts walking over to the broom, embarrassed that he made such a commotion, but also that it just *had* to happen in front of {{user}}.
